request.name: General PDF or image drug label compliance verification

description.content: Upload an animal feed, supplement, or veterinary drug PDF/image label. The system extracts product metadata via Gemini, matches it against the caller's own products only (tenant-scoped weighted similarity — never a global search across tenants), and runs the same deterministic validation engine used by the label-generation pipeline (§4.2 engine unification), including the caller-country's approved regulatory ruleset if one exists. If no approved ruleset exists for the country, regulatory verdicts are `UNVERIFIABLE` (`validation.regulatoryStatus.status`), never silently treated as passing. Product matching returns one of three states, never a silent substitute: `matched` (high confidence, same product — `data_mismatch` verdicts are meaningful), `similar` (a different product; zero `data_mismatch` verdicts, surfaced only as information via `productMatchStatus`), or `none` (no candidate — regulations/coherence only). **Always asynchronous**: returns 202 immediately with a `jobId`; poll `GET /background-tasks/{jobId}` (`pending` → `processing` → `completed`|`failed`) for the result. This replaces the old synchronous AI-judged shape this endpoint used to return directly — see API-CHANGES.md Phase 2.

description.content: Applies a set of field-level changes directly (no AI involved — for the AI-assisted equivalent see `POST /labels/{id}/chat`). Requires `update_labels`. A structurally invalid patch (unknown path, unsupported op, missing value, or one that would replace more than 60% of the label's top-level fields — use regeneration for that instead) is returned as a normal 200 `{status:"refused", path, reason, previousValue, errors}`, never an HTTP error — a business-rule refusal is an outcome of the operation, not a transport failure. A patch that would introduce a NEW validation failure that didn't exist before is refused as a 409 conflict rather than silently applied; resubmit the SAME request with `overrideAcknowledged: true` to push it through anyway — same override contract as `POST /labels/{id}/chat`. The override is recorded on the resulting version, tied to the caller's identity.

request.name: Sign off (approve) a label — the human signature on regulated output

description.content:
Approval is not a status toggle: it's a human signature recording who signed, which version, which estimated fields they signed for, which UNVERIFIABLE verdicts they acknowledged, and a frozen label snapshot. It is refused unless the current version passes every gate below, checked in this order. Requires `approve_labels`, plus `publish_global_reference` when `scope: "global"` is used (never grantable to a company- authenticated caller — rejected outright regardless of permissions).
**Refusal order and status codes:** 1. `scope:"global"` requested by a company caller, or by a system user
   without `publish_global_reference` — **403**.
2. Label not found / wrong tenant — **404**. 3. `expectedVersion` doesn't match `label.currentVersion` — **409**. 4. `label.status` is already `"approved"` — **409** (revoke first to
   re-approve).
5. No `ValidationReport` exists at all for this label — **422**. 6. **Gate 1** — the existing `ValidationReport` is stale relative to the
   current version — **409**.
7. **Gate 2** — the report has any FAIL verdict (`!report.passed`) —
   **422**, final, no override.
8. **Gate 3** — any `UNVERIFIABLE` verdict whose `path` is missing from
   `acknowledgedUnverifiable` — **422**.
9. **Gate 4** — any `labelData.estimatedFields` entry missing from
   `signedEstimatedFields` — **422**.
10. **Gate 5** — `riskScore > 50` and the approver is the label's own
    creator — **403** (separation of duties); OR `autonomyTier ===
    "dual_review"` with no `secondApproverUserId` supplied — **422**.
11. **Gate 6** — any regulatory document behind the validation's
    `rulesetIds` is not `status:"approved"` or has `coveragePercent` <
    95 — **422** ("weak backing documents").
